description: (A) Study design and representative hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images for normal skin and four wound-repair modes. The schematic associates Mode 1 with an unhealed gradient, Mode 2 with advancing epithelialization, Mode 3 with near-complete coverage, and Mode 4 with healed scar or scarless tissue. Displayed scRNA-seq sample counts total 38. Spatial datasets comprise 11 human Stereo-seq sections and two Visium sections. Mode 1 is an unhealed shallow-to-deep gradient; Mode 2 contains directional epithelial advancement; Mode 3 contains focal incomplete closure; and Mode 4 represents covered remodeling tissue with scar or hyperplasia and adjacent scarless tissue. Morphological modes are recorded separately from sampling time. Sample aliases and source identifiers are listed in Table S1. H&E scale bars, 500 μm.
